config:
# Every survivor count for N = 4 at 4B, scaled and unscaled: each child, every partial rebuild
# missing one or two children, the full rebuild and round-to-nearest baselines. Extends
# subsets-0.8b to a size where 3-bit children are usable, so the two-of-four rebuilds and the
# opposite-versus-adjacent pairs that set the placement rule are measured where they matter.
name = "subsets-4b"
output = "results/subsets-4b"

[model]
path = "Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B-Base"

[eval]
window = 2048

[grid]
bits = [2, 3, 4]
group_sizes = [64]
children = [4]
phases = [0.5]
rotation = [false, true]
scaling = [false, true]
seed = 0
max_missing = 2
rtn_bits = [2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]
